# A desktop window manager in src owns app windows and their tasks

## Context

First leaf of #21198, and the one that creates `src/desktop/`. The demo's `apps/webdesktop/view/ViewportController.mjs` holds a window manager next to its sign-in and permission code: `windows` and `createdWindows`, `createWindow()`, `openApp()`, `onTaskItemClick()`, `onWindowHeaderAction()`, `onWindowHide()`, `onAppsFilter()`, `hideAllWindows()`, `releaseWindows()`, and the `signOuts` counter that cancels a window load a sign-out overtook (#21100). The order of the windows lives elsewhere, as module state in `view/AppWindow.mjs`.

## The Problem

That logic is what every web desktop needs. Today a consumer can only copy it, and a copy never receives a fix like #21100's. The order cannot be copied safely at all: as module state it is one stack for every desktop on an App worker.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: n/a — moves and generalizes existing behavior; calls none of it wrong.
- `TreeStore#isKept(nodeOrKey)` (`src/data/TreeStore.mjs:792`) says whether the apps store's filter keeps an app.
- A window is a `dialog.Base` (`src/dialog/Base.mjs`: `hide()`, `show()`, `hidden`, `animateTargetId`, `boundaryContainerId`). It floats outside the component tree, so whoever creates it destroys it. It has one fixed `z-index: 1000` (`resources/scss/src/dialog/Base.scss:8`) and no order among dialogs; `toFront` exists nowhere in `src/`.
- The demo's order is module state in `view/AppWindow.mjs` (lines 9-30 and 116-128): a `stack`, `baseZIndex = 10`, `restack()`, and `toFront()` on `mousedown`.
- The demo loads `AppWindow` through `import()` on first open and parents the window's state provider to the desktop's.
- Today's coverage: `test/playwright/unit/apps/webdesktop/view/ViewportController.spec.mjs`.

## The Fix

- `src/desktop/WindowManager.mjs`, `Neo.desktop.WindowManager` (`core.Base`):
  - configs `appStore`, `taskStore`, `windowClass` (a class or an async module loader) and `windowConfig` (`record => config`, merged into each window);
  - `openApp(record)`: create on first open and keep, or show; add or un-minimize its task; bring it to the front;
  - `restore(appId)`: show a minimized window, or bring a visible one to the front;
  - `minimize(appId)` and `close(appId)`;
  - `bringToFront(appId)`: the manager's own stack sets the `z-index` of the windows it created; a `mousedown` on one of them brings it to the front;
  - `reset()`: cancel opens in flight, clear the tasks, hide every window without animation;
  - `destroy()`: destroy what it created, including loads in flight;
  - it listens to the app store's `filter` event and closes the windows of apps the filter no longer keeps.
- Its `@summary` says that a window here is an app window addressed by `appId`, that `windowId` keeps its engine meaning (a browser window), and points at `Neo.manager.Window`.
- `src/desktop/model/Task.mjs` and `src/desktop/store/Tasks.mjs`, moved from the demo.
- The demo's controller creates the manager and delegates to it until the desktop container owns it (a later leaf of #21198); its sign-out calls `reset()`. Its window code and `AppWindow.mjs`'s module-level stack go.
- The window tests move from the controller's spec to a spec beside the manager.
- The Architecture Overview's Structural Inventory gains a `src/desktop/` row.

| What the manager uses of a window | `src/dialog/Base.mjs` | `show()`, `hide()`, `hidden`, its `hide` and `headerAction` events, and the `z-index` the manager sets; any `dialog.Base` qualifies | — | JSDoc | unit |
| `openApp`, `restore`, `minimize`, `close`, `bringToFront`, `reset`, `destroy` | the demo's controller and `AppWindow.mjs` on `dev` | The demo's behavior, with the order per manager instead of per module | An unknown app id is a no-op | JSDoc | unit |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `WindowManager.mjs`, `model/Task.mjs` and `store/Tasks.mjs` exist under `src/desktop/` with `@summary` JSDoc, the manager's carrying the naming rule. The demo uses them; its controller holds no window state (`windows`, `createdWindows`, `signOuts`), and `AppWindow.mjs` no module-level stack.
- [ ] AC-2: Unit specs pin: two opens during one slow load create one window; a minimize keeps the task and a close removes it; a filter that drops an app closes its window, minimized or not; `reset()` during a load creates no window and clears the tasks; `destroy()` destroys created windows and loads in flight; a window brought to the front is above the others of its manager, and two managers keep separate stacks.
- [ ] AC-3: The demo is unchanged for its user: `test/playwright/e2e/webdesktop/PhoneAndTouch.spec.mjs` and the remaining demo unit specs pass.
- [ ] AC-4: The Architecture Overview's Structural Inventory has a `src/desktop/` row.

## Out of Scope

The launcher, the taskbar, the app window and the desktop container (later leaves of #21198); order among floating dialogs the manager did not create; the tear-out of D#21204; everything #21198 excludes.
